video_title: RJ Breaks Down Why The Coaches Association Is Calling This Deal Disrespectful

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Chauncey Billups and the Portland Trail Blazers' ownership
quotes.excerpt: Paul Allen had endless money and was letting them do things how they wanted to do it.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Can I address this thing, I know you have your thing, the Blazers' ownership. Can I ask you guys a question? Do you know who just won the NHL Cup? His team. He is a different type of owner. When you buy a house, you usually remodel the house so you want it. The Blazers, I live in Portland, I adore the Blazers, I love what they are, but Paul Allen had endless money and was letting them do things how they wanted to do it. This man bought the team and is like, this is bad business because I bought it, this is not how I do business. And let me clear away the weeds, let me change the paint on the wall, but at the end of the day, my main goal is to win.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: They just went to the postseason for the first time.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I know that, but we are talking about infrastructure, not necessarily the team. He is saying, I want to start over my way because I paid for it. If I paid for a burger with bun, burger, bun, that is disgusting. But if I give you a dollar fifty, make me the burger the way I want to make a burger.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland Trail Blazers hiring Mike Dunleavy as head coach
quotes.excerpt: JB Bickerstaff called the contract a slap in the face to all coaches.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: The Portland Trail Blazers hired Mike Dunleavy, who is an outstanding coach, man, human, brilliant mind, as their new head coach. Dunleavy takes over after serving as the lead assistant coach for the Minnesota Timberwolves for five seasons and replaces interim head coach Tiago Splitter, who is obviously now the Chicago Bulls. Dunleavy, who brings nearly 30 years of NBA experience, secured a contract that includes one guaranteed year with options for an additional two seasons. JB Bickerstaff called the contract a slap in the face to all coaches. So with that said, do you want to expand? Is this contract disrespectful?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Somebody signed it, so it must not be that disrespectful. Somebody signed it. If nobody, and we know this coach, he has 30 years experience, he signed this contract. So if it is that disrespectful, hey, no thank you. Everyone should be on the same page, no thank you. But somebody took it. Somebody took it pretty quickly. So there is obviously, there must be, this is his first coaching job? This is what your thoughts, Allie?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the scarcity of NBA head coaching jobs
quotes.excerpt: There is one of 30 jobs in the entire world. There is 30 jobs.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: To your point, I agree with what you are saying, somebody signed it. We have friends that are coaches, JB Bickerstaff, Walt, and JJ Redick. Do you know what all of them say? There is one of 30 jobs in the entire world. There is 30 jobs in the entire world. There is 30. And certain guys like Mike, Mike worked me out getting ready for the draft up in Toronto. He was leading our workouts and our draft workout. Mike has been an elite dude, great dude for years. And a lot of these guys like Jamal Mosley, I think Jamal Mosley might have interviewed for head coaching jobs, he might have did like seven or eight different interviews, and then he gets the job. Why would anybody ever take the Sacramento job? It is one of 30. It is one of 30.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: That has to be why. Because there is no way he doesn't feel undervalued.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Yes, but you can be undervalued and still work and prove yourself in one of 30. And betting on yourself in the one of 30, because it is hard to get that. And you see coaches like, you see Tiago Splitter went to Chicago, Jamal Mosley went to New Orleans, once you are in the in that loop, but you got to get in that loop. And so for him to take a bet on himself because it is one of 30, there is only 30 of those jobs. It is statistically harder to be a coach in the NBA than it is to be a player.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the impact of short-term coaching contracts
quotes.excerpt: You might not be here next year. That doesn't even give the coach command.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: It is the worst. You might not be here next year. I got a four-year deal, you might not be here next year. That doesn't even give the coach command. That doesn't even put him in a and I think the group in the locker room that they have in Portland is great, that is not an issue. But like, that is like listening to your stepdad, you not my daddy.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Like you not my real dad. That is literally what it is. He is an interim coach. He is an interim coach. Don't go get a star. If you got a one-year coach, don't go get a star. quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Allie Clifton on Tyronn Lue's contract negotiations with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Remember when the Lakers offered him three years instead of four and he was like, no.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: I know this is different, so I am going to preface with this, but I was thinking this morning when I was listening to all the conversations going around about this, and I know it is because Tyronn Lue was coming off of a championship, having won a championship. But remember when the Lakers offered him three years instead of four and he was like, no. That was three years. And he was like, no, you are not going to disrespect me. And then what happens? The Clippers go get him. And they have had a coach for seven years, because we all told you that Tyronn Lue was an outstanding coach. The Lakers have been through Darwin Ham, Frank Vogel, and now they have JJ Redick.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: And Tyronn Lue, they associated him with LeBron, right? Like LeBron has got three years left on the deal, that is what we are going to offer. And all of us to a man are like, Tyronn Lue is one of the best coaches in this league. He is young, but what we saw with our eyes ain't normal. He is special. I would give JJ the same type of thing.
